properties.name: Before any open problem, the proof method is calibrated on a problem whose answer is known: a fresh agent per round working from the design alone, and the result trusted through the trail, a person's review and an independent re-derivation
properties.statement: Before any attempt on an open problem, the method of working a proof's holes is run on a calibration problem whose answer is known, so success can be counted. The holes are worked with the skills reflow2 serves today, and nothing new is built first; what is missing is recorded as it is met. Each round is a fresh agent given only the design's read-back, never the previous transcript. The result is trusted through its recorded trail and a person's review, plus an independent re-derivation of the closing steps by a second agent that never saw the first. The same agent is also run without reflow2 on the same problem, for comparison.
